introduction: Colorado weatherization provides no-cost energy-efficiency work for qualified homes. A local provider evaluates eligibility and decides which improvements the home needs.
description: Colorado weatherization provides no-cost energy-efficiency work for qualified homes. A local provider evaluates eligibility and decides which improvements the home needs.

sections.who: Eligibility depends on county, household size and income, or enrollment in specified assistance programs. Renters need the owner’s permission. Manufactured homes can be served; RVs cannot.
sections.get: An energy audit guides work such as insulation, air sealing or heating improvements. Approval does not guarantee every listed measure, and a waiting list may apply.
sections.docs:
• Household size and income records or current qualifying-benefit evidence.
  • Address, ownership or rental information.
  • Owner’s permission for a rental and any information on earlier weatherization.
sections.apply:
1. Find the county provider

    Use the map and provider list on the Colorado Energy Office WAP page.

  2. Submit an application

    Use the linked online application or ask the provider for a mailed paper form. Confirm which records it requires.

  3. Arrange the audit and work

    If approved, the provider schedules an energy audit, appropriate improvements and a quality inspection.
sections.after: Ask about the queue before relying on an installation date. This is home improvement assistance, not payment of an overdue utility bill.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Colorado WAP application and services. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Yes, with the property owner’s permission.
Will every approved home receive a new furnace?
No. Measures are selected from the home’s energy audit.
No. Funding, capacity and utility-provider arrangements can affect availability.
Are previously treated homes eligible again?
The state says homes weatherized within the preceding 15 years are not eligible for repeat weatherization.
